concepts.name: artifact rejection
concepts.definition: epochs or channels judged contaminated are dropped before analysis

concepts.name: ICA cleaning
concepts.definition: independent components judged artifactual are removed

concepts.name: CSP + LDA
concepts.definition: common spatial patterns features into a linear discriminant

concepts.name: no cleaning
concepts.definition: the uncleaned signal as the comparison

concepts.name: SNR (evoked / baseline power)
concepts.definition: evoked power over pre-stimulus baseline power

concepts.name: k-fold CV over trials
concepts.definition: folds drawn from trials, subjects mixed across folds

concepts.name: class-correlated artifacts
concepts.definition: artifacts whose occurrence differs between classes

concepts.name: label validity
concepts.definition: whether the reference labels measure what they are taken to measure
